transcript.description: The call transcript: 'Speaker: text' lines, a Zoom WebVTT transcript, or a Google Meet transcript with timestamp lines.

attendees.description: Who was on the call. A string's name is the part before ' ('; e.g. 'Jo Example (Acme Metrics, Head of Operations)'. Next-step owners come only from these names.

our_side.description: Names of the attendees on the seller's side; the follow-up email is written from them.

focus.description: Optional topics to listen for (budget, competitors mentioned, decision process, fit with our ICP: <line>). Each gets a finding or 'Not discussed.' in focus_findings.

include_follow_up_email.description: False leaves out follow_up_email and its report section.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time, and without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed, never used to compute a due date.
